# Second Nature Labs

> Second Nature Labs trains robots for hard-to-staff facility jobs. A remote operator works from the first shift while every action trains the robot on site.

Second Nature Labs trains generalist robots for specific jobs at specific sites. A trained
remote operator does the work from the first shift. Each operator action becomes training
data. As the robot becomes reliable, the operator moves from doing each task to supervising.

The company is starting with overnight quality, sorting, and rework roles at food processing
and packing facilities in California's Central Valley that already run automation. There are
no customer deployments yet.

## Training and evaluation machinery

- [Robot training demo](https://snlabs.dev/decision-layer/): an interactive technical demo
  that shows task breakdown, execution failures, recovery, episode review, and scoring.
- [no-start-env](https://github.com/Jaiparmar940/rlenv): an open technical test environment.
  Software diagnoses simulated vehicle electrical faults using realistic shop tools and is
  scored on the verified repair outcome. This is evidence of measurement discipline, not a
  customer deployment.

## Benchmark results (2026-07, 9 models, 25 episodes per model)

- Mean scores /100: claude-fable-5 86.0, gpt-5.5 82.3, grok-4 74.9, claude-sonnet-5 74.5,
  gemini-3.5-flash 59.7, claude-haiku-4-5 39.9, ministral-3b 23.0, qwen-2.5-7b 20.9,
  llama-3.1-8b 7.2.
- Frontier models have cleared textbook short-horizon automotive diagnosis; the hard tier
  (intermittent CAN fault, compound battery+ground fault) is not saturated — no model
  passes every episode.
